title: South Florida events this week, cheap picks first
igCaption:
III Points returns to Miami this October, and tickets are available for a penny through @iiipoints.
Gulfstream Park has corgi races Saturday, with 40-yard dashes at 1 PM, 1:30 PM and 2 PM.
Brightline is running late-night trains after Kaseya Center shows through the end of the year.
Which one would you actually go to this week?

Sources: Time Out Worldwide, Secret Miami, Eater Miami

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #Wynwood

scenes.text: What’s worth doing in South Florida this week if you want to start cheap?
Start with III Points. The festival returns to Miami this October, and tickets are available for a penny. That is about as close as Miami gets to paying you back.
scenes.caption: Start with III Points. The festival returns to Miami this October, and tickets are available for $0.01. That is about as close as Miami gets to paying you back.

scenes.text: On Saturday, Gulfstream Park runs the Coastal Corgi Classic at 901 S Federal Highway. The dogs race 40 yards on the main dirt track at about 1 PM, 1:30 PM and 2 PM.
scenes.caption: On Saturday, Gulfstream Park runs the Coastal Corgi Classic at 901 S Federal Highway. The dogs race 40 yards on the main dirt track at about 1 PM, 1:30 PM and 2 PM.

scenes.text: Brightline is running late-night trains after Kaseya Center shows through the end of the year. This week, that covers Camilo on October 9, Arcángel on October 11 and KATSEYE on October 13. If you’re on the late train, check NEAR for who was there.

scenes.text: For a restaurant plan, Emelina’s opened in West Palm Beach with 16 seats. The team includes Alvaro Perez-Miranda from Michelin-starred Ogawa, plus chefs Osmel González and Camila Salazar. The tasting menu is $275.

scenes.text: Which one are you picking this week? At events like these, it’s easy to recognize a face from the crowd and never learn the name, and that’s exactly what NEAR quietly makes clear.
